summary: Displays a MessageBoxA using the last active popup window as parent. Lazily loads user32.dll and resolves MessageBoxA, GetActiveWindow and GetLastActivePopup on first call (cached in the function-pointer globals at 0x008D41D8/0x008D41DC/0x008D41E0). Returns the MessageBox result, or 0 if the DLL load or the MessageBoxA resolution fails.
